why: Lateral: helping, advising, and providing service to others is serving sideways, but this is an interest rating (what incumbents are drawn to), so weaker evidence.
Helping, advising, and providing service to others is serving sideways, but as an interest type it reflects what incumbents are drawn to rather than what the work demands.
Social interest — helping, assisting, providing service to others — is service pointed at clients and the public, but it is an interest rating rather than a work demand.
Work defined by following procedures and regulations is the no-discretion face of upward accountability — rules, not the worker, hold the final say; interest rating, so weaker evidence.
Conventional work 'involves following procedures and regulations' — the no-discretion face of upward accountability; low confidence because it is an interest rating and partly topical.

'Following procedures and regulations to organize information' is the low-discretion, account-keeping pole of work — upward-facing subordination to rules — but it is an interest rating, hence weak evidence.
Lateral: providing personal services to individual clients is sideways service; interest-area rating, so weak evidence of what the work demands.
Providing personal services to individuals is client-facing lateral service; interest-area rating, so weak evidence.
Personal Service is providing services directly to individual clients — sideways service — but as a specific interest area it reflects attraction rather than requirement.
Lateral: expert advising and counseling of clients points sideways, but it shades into instruction and is only an interest rating.
Providing expert advice and counseling to clients on careers and development is serving sideways, but it is an interest rating and the recipients' relation is only implicit.
Providing expert advice and counseling to clients is serving sideways — but as an interest area it reflects attraction rather than demand.
Selling is inherently directed at customers — lateral service — but this is an interest rating.
Selling goods or services is directed at clients and the public, but as an interest rating it is weak evidence of what the work demands.
Selling goods or services is client-facing sideways service, but this is an interest rating, weaker evidence than an activity.

Upward, weakly: maintaining and auditing records and accounts is literally account-rendering work whose output exists for review by others, but it is an interest area and auditing can also point the other way.

Accounting work consists of maintaining and preparing records subject to audit and review — producing account for oversight above — but it is an interest area and the auditing half points the other way.
Accounting work is literally maintaining and auditing records for external/superior review — account-rendering — but this is an interest rating, so weaker evidence.
Downward: recruiting, selecting, training, and reviewing employees is staffing and controlling other people; interest-area rating, so slightly weaker evidence.
Recruiting, selecting, training, administering compensation, and conducting performance reviews is staffing and controlling personnel — downward; interest rating, so evidence is somewhat weaker.
Recruiting, selecting, training, and conducting performance reviews is staffing and personnel control — downward — but it is an interest rating, so weaker evidence.
Work involves directing operations and overseeing personnel — clearly downward, but an interest rating so weaker evidence.
Planning, directing and overseeing personnel and operations points downward; medium because it is an interest rating, not an activity demand.
Work involves planning, directing and overseeing personnel — clearly downward, but it is an interest-area rating rather than an activity demand.
Speaking before an audience is directed at outside publics, neither above nor below the speaker; interest rating, so weaker evidence.
Speaking before an audience points laterally at the public, but it is an interest rating and the audience relationship is not accountability
Speaking before an audience is outward-facing engagement with the public, a lateral direction; interest rating, so weak evidence.
Lateral: providing social services and assistance to the public is serving sideways; interest-area rating, so weaker than an activity rating.
Providing social services and assistance to the public is lateral service to non-superiors/non-subordinates; interest rating, so weaker evidence.
Providing social services and assistance to clients is lateral service to non-superiors/non-subordinates; interest rating, so weak evidence.

Reconciling differences among parties is typically dealing with peers or outside parties, but the item states no direction explicitly.
Reconciling differences between parties is typically dealing with peers or outside parties who are neither superiors nor subordinates, though the item names no direction explicitly.
Negotiation reconciles differences between parties treated as peers or outside counterparts — lateral in typical use, but the direction is not fixed by the definition.
Teaching others how to do something is instructing — directing the conduct of people below or under your guidance.
Teaching others how to do something is instructing — the D construct's own verb — though it is a skill rather than an activity rating
Teaching others how to do something points downward -- the instructor directs the learner's conduct; a skill rather than an activity, hence medium.

Determining how money is spent is command over resources (downward control), though the 'accounting for expenditures' clause carries a minor upward face.
Directing the acquisition and use of equipment and materials is downward control of resources.

Obtaining and directing the use of equipment and materials is control over resources, the downward face of the construct

Management of personnel resources — motivating, developing, and directing people, staffing decisions — is directly the activity of commanding others, despite being filed as a skill.
Knowledge element, but knowledge of resource allocation, leadership technique, and coordination of people is required precisely of jobs that command — a direct indicator of downward-directed work.
Knowledge of leadership, resource allocation, and coordination of people is a direct indicator that the job involves commanding people and resources; knowledge rating, so weaker than an activity.

Administration and Management knowledge covers leadership, resource allocation, and coordination of people — a knowledge proxy for holding downward command, indirect because it measures knowing rather than doing.
Knowledge element, but selling and promoting is by nature directed at clients and the public, so the knowledge indicates lateral-facing work.
Selling to customers is client-facing sideways interaction, but this is a knowledge area rather than an activity requirement.
Sales and marketing knowledge is required only where the work faces customers laterally, so the knowledge proxies the client-facing activity — but it is knowledge, not the activity itself.

Knowledge element, but its content is entirely client-directed: assessing customer needs and serving customers is the sideways-serving activity itself, so possessing it directly indicates lateral service work.
Serving customers and clients — people who are neither superiors nor subordinates; knowledge element, but its content is precisely the sideways-service activity
Knowledge element, but it directly indexes serving clients and customers -- people who are neither superiors nor subordinates -- so it indicates lateral service.
Knowledge element, but recruitment, selection, compensation and labor relations are competencies exercised only by those staffing and supervising others — a direct indicator of downward direction.
Knowledge of staffing, selection, compensation and labor relations — a direct indicator of jobs that staff and manage subordinates; knowledge element, so medium.

Knowledge of teaching and training design — proxies instructing others (downward), but is knowledge rather than activity.
Knowledge element, but curriculum design and instruction of others directly indicates the downward activity of teaching

Work consisting of judging events against laws, regulations, and standards places the worker inside an external rule regime whose authority stands above their own judgment; direction is implied rather than stated, hence low.

Work whose judgments must be squared against laws, regulations, or standards — rule-bound justification rather than free discretion; low because the worker here is the evaluator, not necessarily the one overruled.
Judgment exercised against external laws, regulations, and standards — rule-bound work without final say — but the element does not name who overrules the worker, so direction is inferred.
Scheduling 'the work of others' is allocating and controlling other people's activity — downward direction; activity rating, though the item mixes in scheduling events generally.
Scheduling 'the work of others' is controlling other people's activity — downward direction; slightly diluted by scheduling of events generally.
Scheduling 'the work of others' is directing and allocating other people's activity — commanding, though the element also covers scheduling events generally.

Documenting/recording information is the paper-trail act of rendering account — producing the written record someone above can inspect; direction to a superior is implicit rather than stated, hence medium.
Documenting/recording information is the paperwork face of rendering account — records exist to be reviewed and audited by the organisation above the worker; U names documenting explicitly.

Handling complaints, grievances, and negotiations is characteristically done with clients, the public, or outside parties — lateral — though the item leaves the counterpart unspecified.

Dealing directly with the public, customers, clients — interaction pointed sideways at people who are neither superiors nor subordinates.
Dealing directly with the public, customers, clients — serving sideways to people who are neither superiors nor subordinates; an activity rating with explicit direction.

Activity of getting group members to work together — directing others' work, pointing downward.
Activity of coordinating and directing the work of others — commanding downward.

Building and leading teams is directing others; the activity presumes a leadership position over the team members.
Teaching and instructing others is downward-directed activity — the worker directs learners.
Activity of instructing and developing training for others — instructing is downward direction per the construct.
Teaching and instructing others is directing people below or under one's guidance; activity rating

Activity of coaching, mentoring, and developing others — instructing people whose development you are responsible for, the downward face of interaction.

Providing guidance and expert advice TO MANAGEMENT — rendering reasoned judgment upward to people who hold the final say and can accept or reject it.

Context rating that directly measures dealing with external customers and the general public — interaction pointed sideways at people who are neither superiors nor subordinates.
